observations: Small balance revisions retain exact duration and strong mono retention in all six.
Funky remains 1.86 LU below the review target when constrained by a -3.1 dBTP static ceiling; later bounded peak control is justified.
Coactive support is generally well below the foreground. Sparse backing rests must not be interpreted as a masking fault.
decision.decision: Proceed with small source-specific conditional clarity cuts and player positioning. Preserve the large intentional dynamic ranges of Island and Aquatic. No broad spectral flattening or new instrument substitution.
decision.listening: PENDING: no subjective sound-quality grade recorded.
